name: Praj Industries Ltd
about: Praj Industries Ltd., founded in 1983  is a leading biotechnology and engineering company globally. It offers sustainable solutions in bioenergy, water purification, process equipment, breweries, and wastewater treatment. Company is focused on the environment , energy and farm-to-fuel technology solution. Company has global offices in Thailand, Philippines, and the USA.[1]
keyPoints:
Products portfolio[1]
Its product portfolio is diversified into BioEnergy, Praj HiPurity Systems, Critical Process Equipment & Skids, Wastewater Treatment, and Brewery & Beverages.

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 41.3%
